ai_positioning.summary: Autoliv does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in its 2025 10-K filing. Company disclosure focuses on traditional passive safety systems, manufacturing excellence, quality management, and supply chain optimization without reference to AI-driven technologies.

risks.title: Dependence on major customers
risks.score_rationale: Source explicitly states top 5 customers represent 44% of sales. Risk described as having material negative impact if lost. Customer concentration remained stable year-over-year. High weighting appropriate for industrial supplier business model. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of one or more major customers would materially harm revenue and profitability given concentrated customer base.

risks.title: Quality recalls and increasing quality requirements
risks.score_rationale: Quality is described as critical to business success and central to 10-K discussion. Automotive industry has intensified focus with zero tolerance for deviations. Company has experienced recalls and faces ongoing pressure. Q5 quality initiative and 1P1P supplier program indicate management's response to elevated quality demands. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Vehicle recalls or quality failures could damage reputation, increase costs, and result in loss of customer orders.

risks.title: Raw material and commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Source indicates limited raw material cost impact in 2025 and expects continued limited impact in 2026. Company successfully recovered majority of tariff costs through customer compensation. Risk presence is moderate with effective mitigation mechanisms in place. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Fluctuations in raw material prices and availability could compress margins despite customer compensation mechanisms.

risks.title: Automotive safety regulation evolution
risks.score_rationale: Source identifies increasing government regulations and crash test requirements (Euro NCAP) driving higher safety content requirements. These regulations are creating both opportunities and compliance costs. Trend is positive for company but requires continued investment. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: More stringent safety standards and regulations could increase development and compliance costs while creating product opportunity.

risks.title: Climate change and carbon transition risks
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions EV sales reached 1.7B in 2025. Transition to electric vehicles represents structural shift affecting product mix and manufacturing. Supply chain impacts from climate-related disruptions are potential risk. Company has SBTi-validated climate targets. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Automotive electrification and climate regulations could affect product demand, supply chain stability, and manufacturing footprint.

risks.title: Intellectual property and patent protection
risks.score_rationale: Source indicates patents are important to competitive position but no current litigation mentioned. Risk of patent invalidity or infringement remains theoretical. Stable trend with moderate weighting appropriate for technology-based business. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of patent protection or intellectual property disputes could weaken competitive advantages in safety technology.

risks.title: Supply chain disruption and supplier dependency
risks.score_rationale: Company operates 62 production facilities in 23 countries indicating global supply chain complexity. Supplier quality requirements (IATF 16949) and 1P1P initiative show proactive management. Recent tariff impacts and Nexperia chip situation demonstrate vulnerability to disruptions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Disruption from key suppliers or supply chain partners could impact production capacity, quality, and delivery schedules.

risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainty and tariff exposure
risks.score_rationale: Source explicitly identifies geopolitical uncertainties and tariffs as impacting 2025 results. Company achieved customer recovery for 80% of tariff costs but faces uncertainty on future recovery rates. Trend indicates increasing volatility. Significant impact on profitability and operational planning. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Trade restrictions, tariffs, and geopolitical tensions could increase costs, disrupt supply chains, and reduce customer compensation recovery.

risks.title: Geographic and customer mix dilution of safety content
risks.score_rationale: Source indicates shift in LVP mix toward lower safety content per vehicle regions (China, India growth vs North America, Europe decline) diluted global CPV by 2-3pp. This structural trend continues as expected but moderates organic growth below LVP growth. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Shift in global vehicle production toward lower-content regions and emerging market platforms could pressure average safety content per vehicle and organic growth rates.

company_description: Autoliv, Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and supplies passive safety systems to the automotive industry in the Americas, Europe, China, and Asia. The company offers passive safety systems, such as modules and components for frontal-impact airbag protection systems, side-impact airbag protection systems, pedestrian protection systems, steering wheels, inflator technologies, battery cut-off switches, and seatbelts. It also develops and manufactures mobility safety solutions, including passive safety systems for commercial vehicles; and safety solutions for riders of motorcycles and bikes. The company primarily serves car manufacturers. Autoliv, Inc. was founded in 1953 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
_dividends_source: yfinance dividends + cashflow + income (V3 fallback FY2025)

fr.activity: Autoliv fabrique des systèmes de sécurité essentiels pour les voitures, protégeant les passagers en cas d'accident.
fr.products: Elle produit des airbags pour le conducteur et les passagers, des ceintures de sécurité, et des systèmes de direction assistée.
fr.customers: Ses clients sont les grands constructeurs automobiles mondiaux qui intègrent ses produits dans leurs nouveaux véhicules.
fr.edge: Autoliv est un leader mondial reconnu pour son expertise en sécurité automobile, rendant les voitures plus sûres pour tous.

en.activity: Autoliv manufactures essential safety systems for cars, protecting occupants during accidents.
en.products: It produces driver and passenger airbags, seatbelts, and steering systems.
en.customers: Its clients are major global car manufacturers who integrate its products into their new vehicles.
en.edge: Autoliv is a globally recognized leader in automotive safety expertise, making cars safer for everyone.

de.activity: Autoliv stellt essenzielle Sicherheitssysteme für Autos her, die Insassen bei Unfällen schützen.
de.products: Das Unternehmen produziert Airbags für Fahrer und Beifahrer, Sicherheitsgurte und Lenksysteme.
de.customers: Seine Kunden sind große globale Automobilhersteller, die seine Produkte in ihre Neufahrzeuge integrieren.
de.edge: Autoliv ist ein weltweit anerkannter führender Anbieter von Expertise im Bereich Fahrzeugsicherheit und macht Autos für alle sicherer.

fr.positioning: Autoliv se positionne comme un fournisseur de premier plan (Tier 1) de systèmes de sécurité passive pour l'industrie automobile mondiale. Elle est en concurrence directe avec des acteurs comme ZF Friedrichshafen et Joyson Safety Systems.
fr.tech_products: L'entreprise se distingue par ses systèmes d'airbags avancés (y compris des innovations pour les impacts latéraux et les piétons), ses prétensionneurs de ceinture de sécurité intelligents, et ses volants intégrant des technologies de sécurité.
fr.moat: Son avantage concurrentiel repose sur une forte propriété intellectuelle (brevets sur les technologies de déploiement et de matériaux), des relations de longue date avec les constructeurs automobiles mondiaux, et une chaîne d'approvisionnement globale optimisée pour la production de masse.
fr.risks: Un risque majeur est la dépendance accrue envers un nombre limité de grands constructeurs automobiles, dont la demande peut fluctuer. La transition vers les véhicules électriques et autonomes nécessite des adaptations rapides des technologies de sécurité passive existantes.

en.positioning: Autoliv positions itself as a leading Tier 1 supplier of passive safety systems to the global automotive industry. It competes directly with players like ZF Friedrichshafen and Joyson Safety Systems.
en.tech_products: The company stands out with its advanced airbag systems (including innovations for side and pedestrian impacts), intelligent seatbelt pretensioners, and steering wheels integrating safety technologies.
en.moat: Its competitive advantage lies in strong intellectual property (patents on deployment and material technologies), long-standing relationships with global car manufacturers, and a global supply chain optimized for mass production.
en.risks: A significant risk is the increased dependence on a limited number of major automotive manufacturers, whose demand can fluctuate. The transition to electric and autonomous vehicles requires rapid adaptation of existing passive safety technologies.

de.positioning: Autoliv positioniert sich als führender Tier 1-Zulieferer von passiven Sicherheitssystemen für die globale Automobilindustrie. Es konkurriert direkt mit Akteuren wie ZF Friedrichshafen und Joyson Safety Systems.
de.tech_products: Das Unternehmen zeichnet sich durch seine fortschrittlichen Airbagsysteme (einschließlich Innovationen für Seiten- und Fußgängeraufprall) sowie intelligente Gurtstraffer und Lenkräder mit integrierten Sicherheitstechnologien aus.
de.moat: Sein Wettbewerbsvorteil liegt in starkem geistigem Eigentum (Patente auf Entfaltungs- und Materialtechnologien), langjährigen Beziehungen zu globalen Automobilherstellern und einer optimierten globalen Lieferkette für die Massenproduktion.
de.risks: Ein erhebliches Risiko ist die zunehmende Abhängigkeit von einer begrenzten Anzahl großer Automobilhersteller, deren Nachfrage schwanken kann. Der Übergang zu Elektro- und autonomen Fahrzeugen erfordert eine schnelle Anpassung bestehender passiver Sicherheitstechnologien.
